author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Zapier Next Gen Zaps step by step. Next Gen Zaps use AI to build powerful automations simply by describing what you want to happen, without needing to code.

In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to create a Next Gen Zap from scratch, connect your apps, build branching workflows with AI, test and troubleshoot your automation, view the underlying TypeScript code, manage workflow runs and versions, and make changes using natural language.

We’ll build a real automation using Google Forms, Gmail, Slack, and Google Sheets. You’ll also learn how to connect Zapier to ChatGPT using MCP so you can create and manage Next Gen Zaps directly from ChatGPT.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Sponsor: Zapier
